prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing desktop anchors & pet assets...", "Your pet will anchor to your desktop taskbar when ready."]
1: ["Meet your future desktop companion in real-time", "Choose Your Path"]
2: ["Your Desktop Is About to Get Lively", "See how your pet will walk on your taskbar, react to windows, and keep you company.", "Desktop Pet Preview Animation", "Choose My Companion Path"]
3: ["Save & Sync Your Pet Across Reboots", "Sign in to keep your custom pet safe and accessible anytime on this computer.", "Sign In to Preserve Pet", "Prevents accidental pet reset when re-opening the desktop app."]
4: ["You can minimize this window! We will alert you on desktop when ready.", "Background Desktop Anchor Active"]
5: ["Your Pet Has Arrived on Your Desktop!", "Look at the bottom right corner of your screen. Click your pet to talk, or right-click the tray icon to adjust settings.", "Start Playing"]
6: ["Choose Companion Species", "Live Desktop Animation Preview"]
7: ["Connection taking longer than expected? Click retry below to reload auth options.", "Retry Sign-In Connection"]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your new companion is officially registered and bound to your computer session.", "Verified Desktop Companion Seal"]
9: ["Welcome Gift Unlocked: Starter Toy & Treat Pack!", "Claim Gift & Launch Pet"]
